scope: Literature support for the biological plausibility of the Arabidopsis root cell-identity taxonomy used in the Plant-CellFM v9 public-data computational case.
claim_boundary: This is not wet-lab validation. Plant-CellFM marker genes remain computational marker candidates.

sources.citation: Jean-Baptiste et al., Dynamics of Gene Expression in Single Root Cells of Arabidopsis thaliana
sources.evidence_role: Major root groups and canonical marker examples including COBL9, SCR, MYB46, APL and SUC2.

sources.citation: Shahan et al., A single cell Arabidopsis root atlas reveals developmental trajectories in wild-type and cell identity mutants
sources.evidence_role: Organ-scale root atlas with root cap, epidermis, ground tissue and stele branches plus phloem/xylem subtypes.

sources.citation: Ryu et al., Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Resolves Molecular Relationships Among Individual Plant Cells
sources.evidence_role: Arabidopsis root scRNA-seq identifying major root tissue types including root cap, root hair, nonhair, cortex, endodermis and stele.
